quest.title: The Dealing Sands
quest.description: Two groups of unknown individuals are fighting fiercely in the wilderness. What in the world is going on?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

dialogues.speaker: Iron Dou'er
dialogues.text: We drink out of the same bottle, yeah? We don't say "thanks" for such big favors, you're ever in a jam, you just holler and it'll be done in a flash!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, you're pretty polite!

choices.text: I'll get to the point then. I've been a little tight on money lately.

response.speaker: Iron Dou'er
response.text: You need Mora? Haha, well, funny thing is, there could be a little problem with that—

response.speaker: Iron Dou'er
response.text: Our Mora? The big cheese took it all. We been down on our uppers, flat broke here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Big Cheese?

response.speaker: Iron Dou'er
response.text: Our Boss, the leader of us Iron and Salt Gang. He's with a bunch of Fontainian cats down at the bottom of the cliff over there, left us behind to hold down the fort.

response.speaker: Iron Dou'er
response.text: But you saw what happened too, right? Those Fontainian frogs snuck in while the big shot was away and stabbed us in the butt, really put the screws to us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eek... Stabbed you in the butt...!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yikes...!

response.speaker: Iron Dou'er
response.text: Brat! Really trying to take us for a ride?

response.speaker: Iron Dou'er
response.text: Since they tipped their mitts and showed their mugs here, our Boss is probably gonna get double-crossed too. Whaddaya say, bo? In for a Mora, in for the lot, you wouldn't back out now, would ya?

response.speaker: Iron Dou'er
response.text: As long as Boss is safe, you're guaranteed the swankiest of meals, and can live the good life!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Where is he? I'll go check it out.

response.speaker: Iron Dou'er
response.text: On that beach beneath the cliff. You'll see when you get there.

response.speaker: Iron Dou'er
response.text: I'll leave you to it, and be on over after I finish here.

choices.text: Just doing my part to uphold justice.

response.speaker: Iron Dou'er
response.text: Supremely honorable! Righteous beyond measure! In that case, I got something juicy to tell both of you.

response.speaker: Iron Dou'er
response.text: Our big cheese... He's probably in a jam himself, probably needs some help, yeah?

talks.objective: Go to the beach beneath the cliff
Participate in negotiations between the two parties

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ming
dialogues.text: We've been pals, Johnnie, so I get the pickle you've found yourself in lately.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ming
dialogues.text: You could've just talked to me straight, but causing a mess like this... It's enough to break my heart.

dialogues.speaker: Johnnie
dialogues.text: Well, pal, you know business as usual is no longer the usual over here. The Spina di Rosula's on the rise, and my brothers are a bit out of sorts...

dialogues.speaker: Johnnie
dialogues.text: But I still got to look after all the birds in my crew. If this keeps up, they won't even get crumbs...

dialogues.speaker: Johnnie
dialogues.text: We got good business going between us, it's pretty reasonable, but if you can give us more... I'm sure we all know I'll scratch your back in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Johnnie
dialogues.text: If not... Haha, there are plenty of other fish in the sea, Iron Ming, it's not like you can't find new friends!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ming
dialogues.text: So I take it that means this is your final offer, right, Johnnie?

dialogues.speaker: Johnnie
dialogues.text: You got a problem with what I'm offering?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Chuan'er
dialogues.text: You kidding me, Mr. Fontainer? Just tell us what you're up to! Who are you trying to steal from with this little money? Stop shouting nonsense!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ming
dialogues.text: Shut it!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ming
dialogues.text: Listen, Johnnie, the Don Pesci family pays me 58 thou a box, and the De Niro 70 thou. I shouldn't have to tell you just how big they are in Lumidouce Harbor, yeah?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ming
dialogues.text: But for you, I only asked for a hundred grand for three boxes, and even threw in special pick-up and delivery service on top... Now why do I do that? Because I cherish you as a friend.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ming
dialogues.text: No need for me to harp on all that... I'm sure you just didn't think it through! Let's find a place to drink while we talk, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Johnnie
dialogues.text: Hehe, I don't need all that. I know how you Liyue people get about contracts. Since the point of contracts is fairness, I don't think friendship supersedes that.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ming
dialogues.text: Hehe, Brother Johnnie! Someone who understands the spirit of contracts so well... My men ought to learn from you, ha!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ming
dialogues.text: It's just that... at least on this matter, I'd like to see you guys respect the contract more.

dialogues.speaker: Johnnie
dialogues.text: Of course, of course! You're being more than reasonable, and the ancient Liyue tradition of upholding contracts is something we can all admire. I suppose I must find a way to prove my sincerity.

dialogues.speaker: Johnnie
dialogues.text: Walker, you think we can raise our offer... say, one Mora per item?

dialogues.speaker: Walker
dialogues.text: That's very generous, Mr. Johnnie. These good people of Liyue have worked so hard for us, so we do owe them one extra Mora per item.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Chuan'er
dialogues.text: Fontainian frogs! Just what are you trying to pull here!?

dialogues.speaker: Johnnie
dialogues.text: Come on, old pal, can't you just feel my sincerity radiating off of me from where you're standing?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ming
dialogues.text: I take it you're gonna breach our agreement, then, Johnnie?

dialogues.speaker: Johnnie
dialogues.text: Oh? Am I? What do you think, Walker?

dialogues.speaker: Walker
dialogues.text: Mr. Johnnie, there's plenty of other fish in the sea, if you ask me. Any minnow should know that.

dialogues.speaker: Johnnie
dialogues.text: I'm ashamed of you, Walker. How could you insult our Liyue friend like that?

dialogues.speaker: Johnnie
dialogues.text: I mean, we're going to take over their turf soon anyway, shouldn't we show a bit of gratitude?

dialogues.speaker: Walker
dialogues.text: Sorry, Mr. Johnnie.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Chuan'er
dialogues.text: You slippery bastards! The audacity to plan something like that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Whoa, calm down with the insults! No need to be rude.

dialogues.speaker: Johnnie
dialogues.text: Hey, who are the two youngsters...?

dialogues.speaker: Johnnie
dialogues.text: Well, now this is interesting. Are all Liyue little children brave like them? Walker!

dialogues.speaker: Walker
dialogues.text: Hey, where did you snotty kids come from? Here's some Mora. Now scram, run on back to your mommies!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Don't any of you have any manners?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ming
dialogues.text: And who are you two...?

choices.text: We're here for a super swanky meal.

response.speaker: Johnnie
response.text: Hahaha! From the sound of it... Looks like you're Mr. Iron Ming's rusted little help?

response.speaker: Johnnie
response.text: So, you had the same idea too, eh, Mr. Iron Ming? Well, we didn't exactly come unprepared. Walker!

response.speaker: Walker
response.text: Come out, boys, it's time!

response.speaker: Iron Chuan'er
response.text: What!?

response.speaker: Johnnie
response.text: Oh dearie me, guess what? I think we have more people on our side.

response.speaker: Johnnie
response.text: I am so, so sorry, Mr. Iron Ming. Before our little meeting, I made prior arrangements to have the people guarding your camp taken care of.

response.speaker: Johnnie
response.text: Now it's your turn. I'll make sure your business is in good hands.

response.speaker: Iron Ming
response.text: "Boss" Johnnie... If you wanna get a slant at our business, it won't be duck soup!

response.speaker: Johnnie
response.text: Well, I hope you can back up your tough talk. Get him!

choices.text: We're here to make certain somebodies run on back to their mommies.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ming
dialogues.text: Two incredible heroes! I am in your debt!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's quite alright! No matter where you make a deal, you should always honor your contract!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ming
dialogues.text: #Hehe, this little {M#hero}{F#heroine}'s got the picture! Still, you two seem wise to our deal. Why?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Iron Dou'er told us about it. She said you were bootlegging or somesuch...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But what does "bootleg" mean?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Some sort of illegal transaction.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ming
dialogues.text: In that case, I must repay you two chivalrous heroes.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ming
dialogues.text: Boys! Come truss them up nice and tight and toss them into the sea!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ming
dialogues.text: Be sure to tie a few extra rocks to them, too. They did us Iron and Salt Gang a big favor, so let's not make them suffer more than they should!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!? You... You want to do WHAT to us!?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ming
dialogues.text: My dear little hero, from what you just said, I would've thought you'd understand. Liyue is indeed a place very particular about contracts.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ming
dialogues.text: And walking in on a transaction between outlaws means you get silenced. Surely that is an unspoken contract known to all?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's no such thing as that contract! Repaying our kindness with murder is the real breach of contract here!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ming
dialogues.text: Please don't make this harder on yourselves. If I have to do it myself, you'll be in for a world of hurt.

choices.text: Do you know who I am?

response.speaker: Iron Ming
response.text: Shut up! Iron Dou'er, Iron Chuan'er, just what are you waiting for? Get them!

response.speaker: Iron Chuan'er
response.text: Boss Iron Ming... You really are heartless. Unjust.

response.speaker: Iron Dou'er
response.text: As long as we can stop villains like you from befouling Liyue with your criminal conduct, all of our efforts will have been worth it.

response.speaker: Iron Dou'er
response.text: Round 'em up!

response.speaker: Iron Ming
response.text: Wh—What...!?

response.speaker: Iron Dou'er
response.text: Iron Ming, you lowly scum! Open your eyes and take a good look at us! Who are we?

response.speaker: Iron Ming
response.text: M—Millelith!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, whoa, slow down a sec! What's going on? Why the sudden...

response.speaker: Iron Ming
response.text: I thought you were just newbies, I never imagined you were a bunch of cursed sleuths...

response.speaker: Iron Ming
response.text: Don't count on me going quietly! Bring it on!

choices.text: Oh no, I'm shaking in my boots!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Chuan'er
dialogues.text: This trip was really worth it! Not only did we get who we came for, but we also got to meet the famous Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You know us?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Dou'er
dialogues.text: Of course. I have relatives in Liyue Harbor, and I've heard all about you, so I recognized you from the get-go.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Dou'er
dialogues.text: But there were too many ears around, and I didn't want to risk spooking them, so I didn't come clean. Sorry about that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So it wasn't an illegal deal we butted in on, but a bust?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Chuan'er
dialogues.text: Correct. We've had our eyes on these smugglers for a while now, but only managed to infiltrate them recently with a bit of timely assistance.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Chuan'er
dialogues.text: It's been about a month since then, but today we finally got the opportunity to nab the Iron and Salt Gang and the big Fontainian fish all in one fell swoop.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Dou'er
dialogues.text: Not to mention the fact that those Fontaine fellows almost wiped us out with their dirty tricks. We were fortunate to have your help, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Dou'er
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, you'll have to take a rain check on the swanky feast we promised. However, we do have some Mora for you. Please, take it.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Dou'er
dialogues.text: And don't even think about saying no. You should be rewarded for helping others. That's the contract we should all uphold. Otherwise, in the future, fewer and fewer people will be willing to extend the hand to those in need.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Chuan'er
dialogues.text: Okay, we should probably clean the rest of this up. We won't hold you up any longer.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Chuan'er
dialogues.text: Best of luck to you both!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Dou'er
dialogues.text: C'mon, fellas! Rip the clothes off these Fontainian frogs! Shirts, jackets, don't leave a thread on them!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Chuan'er
dialogues.text: Traveler! You came too.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Dou'er
dialogues.text: Don't worry, we'll take care of the rest. These gangsters won't make trouble in Liyue again.

dialogues.speaker: Qingye
dialogues.text: I don't think this outfit I got fits me...

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Who cares? I got a smelly one and you don't see me complaining!

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Hurry up! Treasure Hoarder outfits are hard to come by, so don't be so picky!

dialogues.speaker: Lingxiao
dialogues.text: This area is unsafe as of late. Tourists and travelers should take a detour.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Yijun
dialogues.text: Based on the report from that merchant, it should happen in the next few days.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What about the next few days?

dialogues.speaker: Yijun
dialogues.text: Oh? You two are...? Sorry, it was nothing important, just talking about some... guild matters.

dialogues.speaker: Yijun
dialogues.text: You're tourists, right? Chenyu Vale is a very scenic area. You've come to the right place.

dialogues.speaker: Yijun
dialogues.text: Why not check those sights out instead of wasting your time in this boring place? Ha!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Chuan'er
dialogues.text: Are you here for the scenery, my friends?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Chuan'er
dialogues.text: There's nothing to see around here. I suggest you go elsewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Chui'er
dialogues.text: Eh...? Huh...? Wait, you look suspicious... You wouldn't happen to be thieves, would you?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Chui'er
dialogues.text: Declare yourselves, or I'm calling for backup...

dialogues.speaker: Iron Gua'er
dialogues.text: Go on, get out of here, git!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Gua'er
dialogues.text: This place is reserved, so scram.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no! What's going on over there? Seems like there's fighting going on!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look! There are so many people on the beach there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That must be the head of the gang that Iron Dou'er mentioned, along with the others!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Shan'er
dialogues.text: We've been caught in a pickle! Nearly zotzed...

dialogues.speaker: Iron Men'er
dialogues.text: Curse that Fontainian Pinky Club, they got no respect for rules! Quick, someone tell the big cheese something fishy is going on!

dialogues.speaker: Yijun
dialogues.text: Based on the report...

dialogues.speaker: Iron Shan'er
dialogues.text: We've been caught in a pickle!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look! There are so many people on the beach there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That must be the head of the gang that Iron Dou'er mentioned, along with the others!
